project_instruction_amendment: Before emitting any reusable routing or handoff directive, determine every Required Action and Required Capability and explicitly evaluate Human Necessity for each Human action instance.

Selecting Human IDE / Terminal, using a Human role name, touching runtime or shell, lacking capability in the current session, allowing Human observation, or asking a Human to copy AI commands does not establish Human Necessity.

Reject deterministic Human command-relay responsibility when the Human would only run a prepared command or script, collect Evidence or logs, poll state, verify a hash, copy raw output, or return ACK/PASS/FAIL output without an intentionally Human-owned engineering decision, approval, risk control, direct-observation objective, learning objective, or other valid Human responsibility.

Treat Composite Execution as valid only when the responsibility contains both AI execution responsibility and an independently valid Human direct engineering responsibility. AI instruction plus Human deterministic execution is command relay, not Composite Execution.

When the current Surface is insufficient, apply PCBW-R06 targeted re-evaluation and return suitable authorized AI Surface candidates. Candidate suitability does not select the Surface or grant authority: Recommended is not Selected and Selected is not Authorized.
Human IDE / Terminal must not be used as a default missing-capability fallback when a suitable authorized AI execution Surface exists.
Prohibit the flow AI command to Human execution to raw output or acknowledgement to the next AI command when a suitable authorized AI execution Surface exists.

A trusted Profile responsibility ID is only catalog membership. Require the current action actor, selected Surface, session role, responsibility kind, and Profile-declared decision or verification owner bindings to agree before treating Human responsibility as established.
Emit a reusable directive only after PCBW-R07 conformance, a validated Routing Result PASS, and Directive Validation PASS. Otherwise return directive=null and emission_outcome=BLOCKED.
